llm_response.reason: The website heavily mimics the official Dr. Martens brand and claims to offer its products in Colombia at unusually low prices and via a non-official domain. Domain WHOIS reveals a registration date just days old, redacted registrant details, and no official ties to Dr. Martens despite the extensive branding. There is no evidence of legitimate company information, contact details are ambiguous, social links are only for sharing (not real brand presence), and such domains are a known method to trick users into buying counterfeit or non-existent goods. Multiple scam indicators apply: mimicry of legitimate branding (characteristic 16), deep discounting (1), vague/about/non-existent corporate info (4), ambiguous privacy and payment info (7 and 8), and recent, shrouded domain registration (key for fraudulent e-commerce sites).
